course.name: Engineering
course.subject: science

course_learning_outcomes: Demonstrate mastery of the course's core knowledge and skills.
Apply concepts through structured practice and authentic tasks.
Demonstrate mastery through weekly, module, and final assessments.

weeks.title: Engineering Design: Scientific inquiry and measurement
weeks.instructor_overview: Introduce and develop scientific inquiry and measurement within the context of Engineering Design. Use explicit instruction, worked examples or models, guided practice, and independent application.
learning_objectives: Describe the scientific concepts associated with scientific inquiry and measurement.
Use evidence, models, or observations to explain scientific relationships.
Apply the concepts to a real or simulated scientific situation.
warm_up: Recall one idea related to scientific inquiry and measurement.
Answer a short retrieval question from the previous week.
Write one question you expect this week's lesson to answer.
lesson_content: Introduction to Scientific inquiry and measurement
Teacher modeling and guided examples for scientific inquiry and measurement
Collaborative practice involving scientific inquiry and measurement
Independent application and reflection
